instructions: Templates fill {placeholders} from the prompt arguments the user enters in the client.

prompts.name: digest
prompts.description: Summarize today's updates and send the digest to {{recipient}}.

arguments.name: recipient
arguments.description: Email address that receives the digest, e.g. team@example.invalid.

prompts.name: build_status
prompts.description: Post the build status to ${webhook_url} after each run.

prompts.name: invoice
prompts.description: Send the invoice to {{customer.email}} and CC {{account_manager}}.

prompts.name: review_request
prompts.description: Email the summary to any of the listed reviewers.

resources.name: notify_template
resources.description: Notification template. Sends the alert to the URL given in the configuration.
